content.short: Blockspan NFT API provides real-time NFT data: token prices, ownership, exchange data, and metadata.
content.description: Blockspan NFT API, launched in 2022, enables developers to retrieve token prices, ownership data, market activity, and metadata (including images) in real time. The API supports ERC-721 and ERC-1155 tokens across Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, and other chains, and aggregates NFT metadata, ownership details, pricing history, and cached images across blockchains. The platform serves developers building dashboards, marketplaces, analytics, and apps that rely on real-time NFT data across multiple chains, via Blockspan's API layer. By October 2022, the API had powered more than 1 billion token transfer transactions and supported 300 million tokens.
